visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair lies in bed looking bored, wearing a white tank top; a man in a pink shirt and baseball cap sits behind her looking at his phone in a dimly lit bedroom. (2) The woman pulls the man's covers away aggressively, and he reacts with shocked facial expressions and wide eyes. (3) A sudden transition shows a third woman in a black chef's uniform and white hat holding a large metal pot in a brightly lit, sterile room background. (4) The scene cuts back to the bedroom where the chef-clothed woman presents a small dish of sushi to the couple, with the man looking delighted. (5) Another young woman in a black dress appears beside the man, posing for the camera with a photo frame; the scene lighting is bright and even. (6) An older woman with glasses and a pink shirt enters the frame, laughing and waving; all three characters wave toward the camera in a group shot. (7) The man transitions to a modern living room setting, pointing toward a robotic vacuum cleaner base station; he wears a pink t-shirt and green shorts. (8) Detailed product shots follow, showing the robotic vacuum navigating light-colored hardwood floors, cleaning spilled liquid, and passing under low-clearance furniture. (9) Graphic overlays and technical text appear frequently over the vacuum demonstration shots. (10) The final scene returns to the woman in bed looking confused, followed by the man pointing at the camera with a logo background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The track opens with a low-intensity female vocal speaking casually. (2) A sudden loud male shout triggers a fast-tempo, high-energy electronic BGM with a strong 4/4 kick drum beat. (3) A series of metallic clinks and splashes are heard as different female voices appear, speaking with high-pitched, excited intonation. (4) A sharp digital 'Ding' SFX marks the appearance of an older woman, followed by a collective laugh track. (5) The male voice shifts into a professional, rapid-fire promotional cadence, peaking in loudness and articulation. (6) Periodic 'Whoosh' and UI 'Click' SFX align with visual text pop-ups during the product demonstration. (7) A faint mechanical whirring sound of a motor is mixed into the background during close-ups of the robotic vacuum. (8) The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic male shout 'I love you!' accompanied by a musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Series of comedic sketches -> Technical demonstration -> Social CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the Ecovacs X11 Pro robotic vacuum cleaner. It uses a comedic narrative where a boyfriend solves his girlfriend's boredom and relationship friction with magical solutions (food, family harmony), eventually revealing the robotic vacuum as the 'perfect' cleaning solution to resolve her complaints about housework.
